ukiepc-2022.notes: The pack lists this seed as role web, but the copy is only the scoreboard page (1 page): it is a scoreboard source. Last team row has cells for only two of the 12 problems. The problem names in the column-header hover titles (Arm Coordination, BnPC, Cangaroo, Decelerating Jump ...) differ from the catalogue's problem list for 2022 (Alpine Pass, Boulder Wall ...); a human should check which is right.
